{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# We'll look for commas in the string values
df['has_comma'] = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many rows have commas
df['has_comma'].sum()"}
